{{Quote|&hellip;I saw a tall man wearing the garments of an Argazdan slave lord sweep past us. At first I assumed he was one of the actors in costume, but then I recognized him as Dr. Raygar. Both the Argazdans and the Lorrdians in the crowd were extremely offended by his attire, and a few spat on his robes as he passed by.|Tash Arranda|<ref name="Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/feature20090531/index.html?page=1|text=Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd: A Hyperspace Exclusive|int=Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd}}</ref>}}
[[File:Raygar-Ewoks.png|thumb|right|Raygar was disdained for dressing as an Argazdan slave lord.]]
A '''slave lord''' was a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]]-owning member of the [[Argazdan/Legends|Argazdan]] aristocracy on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Argazda/Legends|Argazda]]. They were noted for their distinctive attire. Even after the end of slavery on Argazda, the [[academician]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Raygar]] still dressed as a slave lord, a fashion decision that offended other people on the planet.
